answer: Cosignatures are collected in relic, verified in dune, and voyage names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 12 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 206 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
